citation.authors: Li Z, Jiang W, Chen Y, Wang G

cited_by.title: Sauna and heat bathing: heart health, recovery and risks

record.population: People in 16 studies of sauna treatment (healthy people and people with heart problems)
record.design: Meta-analysis of acute and short-term cardiovascular effects
record.finding: Straight after a sauna, body temperature rose 0.94 degrees C and heart rate 18 beats a minute, and systolic and diastolic blood pressure fell by about 5.6 and 6.5 mmHg. Over 2 to 4 weeks, flow-mediated dilation, ejection fraction and walking distance rose and blood pressure fell. The authors describe the trials as limited.
record.note: Short effects on surrogate measures. Ethnicity not reported in the abstract.
